verdict.rationale: Perplexity has a dedicated rate-limits and usage-tiers docs page. It describes a self-serve upgrade path: spending more on API credits automatically moves you to higher tiers with more requests per minute, and tiers are kept permanently with no downgrade. The evidence does not show the actual per-tier numbers or any concurrency caps. missing for 10: concrete published RPM/token limit values per tier, documented concurrency caps, independent corroboration of the tier mechanics.
